verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents an official CLI that manages flags, segments, features, projects and environments from the terminal and can evaluate flags the way an SDK would. A probe confirms the official CLI docs page exists. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI, and documentation of agent-friendly specifics such as machine-readable output and non-interactive auth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The Flagsmith CLI lets you manage flags, segments, features, projects and environments from your terminal, and evaluate flags the way an SDK would.
